values.value:
• KPI strip: three at-a-glance counters. Tiles turn red when there's something to look at: Apex jobs failed today, nightly ETL cron status, and errors in the last 24 hours.
  • Apex Jobs panel: framework batches that ran (or are running) in the last 24 hours. Failed rows are tinted red. Click the chevron on a row with an ExtendedStatus to read the full stack trace inline.
  • Scheduled Jobs panel: framework crons (Vital Reports Nightly ETL and any "CR_"-prefixed schedules). If the nightly cron is missing, you'll see an amber alert with a Schedule Nightly ETL button — click once to register it.
  • Recent Errors panel: Dashboard_Run__c and Dashboard_Component_Run__c rows whose Status = Failed in the last 7 days. Click the chevron to expand and see the recorded error message.
  • Refresh: the page does not auto-poll. Click Refresh to re-query all panels at once.
